cues.zh: 這個函式相當實用，值得認識並熟悉。

cues.zh: 所以這次練習希望你用這個方法拆分矩陣。

cues.zh: 好，希望你享受完成這個練習的過程。

cues.en: Now the method split is a method that operates on PyTorch tensors.
cues.zh: split 方法作用於 PyTorch 張量。

cues.en: It does not operate on numpy arrays or Python lists or dictionaries or any other kind of variable.
cues.zh: 它不適用於 NumPy 陣列、Python 串列、字典，或其他任何種類的變數。

cues.en: It's really just on PyTorch tensors.
cues.zh: 它確實只適用於 PyTorch 張量。

cues.en: So to get this to work, you actually need to first convert this masked array matrix into a PyTorch
cues.zh: 所以要讓它運作，首先必須將這個遮罩陣列矩陣，轉換為 PyTorch

cues.en: tensor, and only then can you use the split method on that tensor.
cues.zh: 張量，接著才能使用張量的 split 方法。

cues.en: So that was actually one of my goals for this exercise was to get you to, uh, know about this method,
cues.zh: 這其實是這個練習的目標之一：讓你認識這個方法，

cues.en: but also appreciate that there are times when there are certain methods or functions that are really handy to use, but you need to do a data type conversion in order to be able to use them.
cues.zh: 也了解有些時候，特定方法或函式雖然很好用，卻需要先轉換資料型態，才能使用。

cues.en: Okay, so the way that you use this split method is to provide at least one input and possibly two.
cues.zh: 好，使用 split 方法時，至少要提供一個輸入，也可能要兩個。

cues.en: And the first input is the number of rows or the number of elements that you want to split by.
cues.zh: 第一個輸入，是要按多少列或多少個元素來拆分。

cues.en: In this case, it's n dimension, because this matrix here is embeddings times three for the q, k and v matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡就是嵌入維度，因為這個矩陣是嵌入維度乘以三，分別對應 q、k、v 矩陣。

cues.en: And then you need to specify the dimension along which you want to split the one input into however many it ends up being.
cues.zh: 接著指定，要沿哪個維度，將這一個輸入拆成最後得到的幾份。

cues.en: So this matrix is has the number of columns corresponding to n embed times three.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣的欄數，對應 n_embed 乘以三。

cues.en: So that's why the first input is n embed.
cues.zh: 所以第一個輸入是 n_embed。

cues.en: And then because we're separating by columns which are the second dimension I write dim equals one.
cues.zh: 而因為是按欄拆分，欄是第二個維度，因此寫 dim=1。

cues.en: And that gives me the three matrices.
cues.zh: 這樣就得到三個矩陣。

cues.en: Pretty handy function to be familiar with.
cues.zh: 這是很值得熟悉的實用函式。

cues.en: In particular, the percent of significant neurons that had significant beta values.

cues.zh: 也就是否定詞與肯定詞的活化有顯著差異的神經元，整體

cues.en: As we go deeper into the layer, so that looks qualitatively very similar to the MLP.

cues.en: And here we see also very similar to what we saw with the MLP neurons, that the prediction accuracy

cues.zh: 準確率，從大約 70%、75%，降到大約 60%，也許再低一點。

cues.en: Now, by the way, the fact that these include only the significant positive betas neurons with significant
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這裡只包含 beta 為正且達顯著的神經元，

cues.en: positive betas tells you that even amongst the neurons where the prediction is significant, the prediction accuracy is lower.
cues.zh: 因此它告訴我們，即使只看預測顯著的神經元，預測準確率仍然較低。

cues.en: So even though there still we're only plotting these significant neurons.
cues.zh: 也就是說，我們畫出的仍然只是顯著神經元，

cues.zh: 只是挑選這些顯著神經元，

cues.en: The magnitude of the effect the effect size is generally pretty low.
cues.zh: 效果的大小，也就是效果量，整體仍然相當低。

cues.en: Also remember that 50% corresponds to chance level literally purely guessing.
cues.zh: 也記住，50% 對應隨機機率水準，完全只是猜測。

cues.en: And so this is technically significantly better than chance.
cues.zh: 所以嚴格來說，這確實顯著優於隨機機率水準，

cues.en: But it's not that much better.
cues.zh: 但沒有好太多。

cues.en: This first point here is very general about coding.
cues.zh: 這裡第一點，是關於寫程式的一般性看法。

cues.en: Taking the time to understand and write out code is always time well spent and wisely invested.
cues.zh: 花時間理解並寫出程式，總是值得的時間投入。

cues.en: This is particularly true when you're learning a new field.
cues.zh: 尤其在學習一個新領域時，更是如此。

cues.en: I know it's very tempting to like vibe code and have ChatGPT or some other LLM write a lot of code for you.
cues.zh: 我知道，讓 ChatGPT 或其他 LLM 幫你寫很多程式，進行 vibe coding，確實很有誘惑力。

cues.en: Now, I do sometimes get llms to code for me, but my honest opinion is that it's usually not worth it.
cues.zh: 我有時也會請 LLM 幫忙寫程式，但老實說，我覺得通常不值得。

cues.en: Partly because still, after all this time, I find that ChatGPT makes a lot of coding errors, but
cues.zh: 部分原因是，經過這麼久，我仍然發現 ChatGPT 會犯很多程式錯誤，

cues.en: also because if you do not take the time to really understand the code that you're using, then it's hard to know what the code is doing.
cues.zh: 另一個原因是，如果不花時間真正理解自己使用的程式，就很難知道它究竟在做什麼。

cues.en: It's even harder to trust that you're doing it correctly in different applications.
cues.zh: 更難確信自己在不同應用中，都用得正確。

cues.en: Now, that said, I do find ChatGPT very useful for helping me debug my own code.
cues.zh: 話雖如此，我確實覺得 ChatGPT 很適合幫忙除錯我自己寫的程式。

cues.en: But anyway, this is just a bit of a meta comment about using Llms in a course about understanding Llms.
cues.zh: 總之，這只是在一門理解 LLM 的課程中，對使用 LLM 做的一點整體評論。

cues.en: The main thing I wanted to say here is that although you will find differences across different transformer layers and different populations of artificial neurons.
cues.zh: 這裡主要想說的是，雖然不同 Transformer 層，以及不同人工神經元群體之間，會有差異，

cues.en: The population level differences are generally more quantitative than qualitative.
cues.zh: 但群體層級的差異，通常比較偏向量化程度，而不是質性的差異。

cues.en: That is to say, the characteristics and the features that you will find in one part of the model, you'll probably find everywhere else in the model.
cues.zh: 也就是說，在模型某個部分發現的特性與特徵，很可能在模型其他地方也找得到。

cues.en: Now, maybe more of those characteristics you'll find in one part or a different part.
cues.zh: 只是其中一些特徵，在某個部分或另一部分可能比較多。

cues.en: But it does seem like the representations and the calculations in Llms are really distributed within and across layers.
cues.zh: 但看來，LLM 中的表徵與計算，確實分布在同一層內，以及不同層之間。

cues.en: They're not really modularly different the way that, for example, your liver and your lung are qualitatively doing completely different things.
cues.zh: 它們並不像肝臟與肺臟那樣，以模組化方式執行質性上完全不同的工作。

cues.en: And that's probably a good final statement for this section and a good segue into the next section where we will focus on a higher level of organization in Llms.
cues.zh: 這大概很適合作為本章的結語，也能銜接下一章，屆時會聚焦在 LLM 更高層級的組織方式。
